links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of chatbot responses to patient questions on orthognathic treatment
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across chatbots; Gemini and ChatGPT responses were more accessible than Copilot's. No numeric scores or comparison with patient literacy level appear in the abstract.
links.quote: Readability varied significantly with Gemini and ChatGPT producing more accessible responses than Copilot.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on standardized patient questions regarding orthognathic treatment without testing a specific deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
